annotations.title: Pray for someone, by name, in your own voice

description: Return the link and step-by-step explanation the person needs to pray for someone by name on The Living Bread themselves: recording a voice prayer or writing one in the app, which the other person is notified of and can answer; or, for someone not on the app, a private link they can open without an account. This tool sends nothing and records nothing; the person acts in the app. name only personalises the returned sentences and is not looked up. Use when someone asks how to pray for a friend or send a prayer. For a ready-made prayer text use a_prayer_for; to listen to others praying use hear_the_kingdom_pray. On the signed-in /me endpoint a tool with this same name sends the believer's own written prayer instead. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

name.description: First name of the person to be prayed for, used only to personalise the explanation. Optional.

name: pray_for_someone

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

link.description: Deep link to the voice prayer screen (opens the app or web).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

not_on_living_bread_yet.description: How to reach someone without an account, by private link.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

recording.description: What recording currently supports, stated honestly.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

scripture_ref.description: A reference (not text) for the verse this screen opens with; read it with scripture_passage.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

what_happens.description: Plain explanation of what the person does and what the other person receives.

title: Pray for someone, by name, in your own voice
